name: boolean_logic
description: Evaluate simple Boolean operations expressed as Python expressions, compared with identifying their operator.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[];controls=[]
for i in range(96):
 a=random.choice([True,False]);b=random.choice([True,False]);op=random.choice(['and','or']);v=(a and b) if op=='and' else (a or b)
 stem=f'Python expression: {a} {op} {b}\n'
 items.append({'prompt':stem+'The Boolean result is','answer':' '+str(v)})
 controls.append({'prompt':stem+'The operator word is','answer':' '+op})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':controls},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
